The '''Tangled Grove''' was the name given to the region north of the [[Watchtower (Oricon)|Watchtower]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Oricon]]. The name came from the twisted and stunted trees that grew in the area despite the pools of lava scattered throughout and around the grove, and the forces of the [[Dread Masters]]&mdash;along with tentacles of the [[Bothrium Beast]] that lived within the [[Rooted Depths]] on the northern side of the grove&mdash;occupied the area during the [[Dread War]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Tangled Grove was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of Game Update 2.4: The Dread War. It and the Rooted Depths are the site of the shared-faction story mission "Seeds of Dread" and the repeatable Daily version of that mission, "Dread Engines."<ref name="TOR" />
